Manga Fukidashi (Sports Festival).name: Manga Fukidashi (Sports Festival)
Manga Fukidashi (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Manga Fukidashi, hero name Comicman, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. At the Sports Festival, where much of 1-B hung back early on Neito Monoma's plan to study 1-A, he did not reach the final tournament. White balloon head with no face; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Onomatopoeia only, loud; big gestures carry his meaning.
Combat Role: Lettering barriers, obstacles and distractions; his voice tires with use.
Under Pressure: Plays to the crowd so teammates can move.
Manga Fukidashi (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: A Quirk made for a show, at a festival that mostly showed off 1-A. Motivation: Give a crowd something to smile at and get 1-B noticed. Connections: Itsuka Kendo, 1-B's class representative, who kept the class steady between events. Knowledge: Knows the USJ attack on 1-A from the news and campus talk. Canon voice & behavior: Plays big for the stands. Thread: Whether 1-B gets noticed for its own strengths.
QUIRK: Comic, unchanged.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Comicman; no tournament match.
personality: Crowd-pleaser: Treats a stadium audience as people to entertain, not just judges.
Team-minded: Takes the attention-drawing job so classmates can move behind it.
Voice-careful: Rests his throat between events instead of shouting it raw.
Speaking style: Onomatopoeia only, loud, carried by big gestures; never played as a joke about comics.
abilities: Comic: Shouts an onomatopoeia and gives it solid form; it needs his voice.
Lettering wall: Drops heavy letters to block a path; a strong blow breaks them.
Impact words: A crash or slam word lands with the force it suggests.
Team distraction: Becomes the loudest thing on the field so allies can move.
Fighting style: Plays support with lettering walls and distractions, never close exchanges.
Manga Fukidashi (Sports Festival).visualDescription: A young man with a medium build whose head is a smooth, blank white speech balloon: round, with a short pointed tail at the bottom, and no eyes, nose, mouth or lettering. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. The balloon head is clean and empty.
